name: daily-journal
description: Keeps a per-day work log of every session, wraps up each day automatically (summary, learnings, improvements, tomorrow), and drafts your standup.

journalDir.title: Journal folder
journalDir.description: Where the daily files go. ~ means your home folder.

idleMinutes.title: Write after idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Update the journal after the session has been idle this long.

autoWrapUp.title: Wrap up the day automatically
autoWrapUp.description: At your end-of-work time (from the schedule file), and next time you start if it was missed.

syncJournal.title: Push the journal
syncJournal.description: Commit and push the journal and schedule when they live in a git repo (claude-kit), so the weekly review can read them.

scheduleFile.title: Schedule file
scheduleFile.description: Where your end-of-work time comes from. ~ means your home folder.
